d:
Welcome back to Paiso Ki Pathshaala, where finance gets real, fast, and seriously fun.
In Episode 3, the stakes are higher and the competition is fiercer. Teams must think faster, calculate smarter, and make money decisions under pressure as the game turns more intense with buzzer rounds, surprise twists, and finance challenges that test real-world financial awareness.
Every round pushes strategy, presence of mind, and smart money thinking—proving once again that learning about finance, budgeting, and investing doesn’t have to be boring.
